---
name: Create CBW Data Table
description: 'Create an operational CBW list or data table from a cataloged template pattern.'
argument-hint: 'Entity, real data source, filters, row actions, and route.'
agent: agent
---

Use `create-cbw-screen`. Use the Users, Roles, CRM, or File Manager pattern that best matches the entity. Preserve local TanStack Table v8 contracts and implement search, filtering, empty, error, loading, pagination, keyboard access, and mobile overflow only when supported by the real API.
